app.name: Studio Hub
app.summary: For a solo freelance UX designer juggling clients, notes, tasks and bookings across inbox, notes and spreadsheets. It brings clients with follow-ups, projects with tasks, and self-serve booking for discovery calls, design reviews and workshops into one calm workspace. The core loop is add a client, track notes and tasks to done, open availability and let visitors book themselves, then start each day from today's sessions, follow-ups and overdue tasks.

assumptions.text: Only one freelancer uses the private workspace; no teams, collaborators or client logins.
Each client has one next follow-up date set from a note; marking done clears it, pushing it adds 7 days.
Overdue means follow-up date or task due date is before today and not done; overdue follow-ups sort first and overdue tasks are highlighted.
Open slots are generated by splitting each weekly availability window into back-to-back slots matching the session type duration for the next 14 days, excluding past times.
Cancelling a session removes it and all its bookings; cancelling a single booking frees one seat and keeps the session for others.
Booking email match to an existing client is case-insensitive exact match; no match creates a new Lead client with the booking name and email.
Deleting a client deletes its projects, tasks, notes and bookings; deleting a project deletes its tasks; sessions without bookings remain until cancelled.
Session types start as the three named types and the freelancer can create, edit and delete them; prices are shown as text only.

questions.question: How should slot start times be calculated inside an availability window?
questions.whyItMatters: Changes when visitors can book and whether slots match expected calendar times
questions.defaultAnswer: Split each availability window into back-to-back slots matching the session duration starting at the window start

questions.question: Does the freelancer need to block specific dates like holidays within the next two weeks?
questions.whyItMatters: Adds exception dates to availability scope
questions.defaultAnswer: No, use weekly availability only and cancel individual slots to block time
